chunks: In fact, every one of them wants to be given open books (like the prophets).

key_terms.صُحُفًا: Plural of Suhuf, meaning sheets, pages, or books of revelation.
key_terms.مُنَشَّرَةً: Open, spread out, or displayed publicly for all to see.

ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers demand to see instead of accepting faith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the impatience of the disbelievers who sought immediate, tangible miracles like open scrolls rather than accepting the Prophet through faith and gradual signs. It underscores the distinction between superficial demands for spectacle and the deeper spiritual reality of divine guidance, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the balance between reason and revelation.
